results.title: 11 AI Trends for Healthcare Heading into 2026 - Innovation Leader
results.content: The Most Useful AI Tools for Innovation. I had the opportunity to moderate a panel earlier this week on the top AI trends in healthcare, featuring speakers from the Mayo Clinic, Oracle, UCLA Health, and a former partner at Mass General Brigham’s AI and Digital Innovation Fund. • “I don’t think we’re going to see a lot of deployment of AIs for medical-decision making directly to consumers. • “The deployment of things that have been piloted…across health systems at scale is a trend I see in 2026,” especially in primary care and behavioral health, Bok said. I think that is likely to intensify in 2026, so you’re going to see people really trying to look for how can they deploy these AI tools in the back office as much as possible.”. • “Typically, implementations and adoption [of AI in healthcare] have been slowed, because anytime that you ask for a change in workflow, that’s been a real barrier to adoption,” Bok said.

results.title: AI in Healthcare: Top Trends for 2025-2026 | Timspark
results.content: # Future of AI in Healthcare: Trends to Watch in 2025. AI has become a part of our lives, especially in such an important field as healthcare. Despite traditional conservatism in medicine, factors such as the aging population and the COVID-19 pandemic have made the use of AI not only possible but even necessary. So, what is the future of AI in healthcare? Let’s delve into healthcare trends in 2023 and beyond. ## AI Technology Trends in Healthcare. Among the digital trends in healthcare, it is worth noting the following ones:. At the slightest suspicion that a patient is in danger, AI will alert a human doctor. Meanwhile, the server-based AI solution can process large volumes of data transmitted from hundreds of thousands of devices simultaneously while applying a personalized approach to monitoring each patient’s health. The asthma app developed by our team is an example of AI-powered software that can be used as a virtual assistant for patients and medical staff.

results.title: The Future of AI in Healthcare – 2026 | SS&C Blue Prism
results.content: **2026** prediction: With labor shortages affecting the healthcare industry, providers can use AI agents to speed up the process of finding qualified staff, streamline administrative tasks and help clinicians make informed decisions. **2026 prediction:** Healthcare providers will keep using RPA but enhance their automated workflows even further with AI agents. RPA provides a stable foundation for healthcare automation while AI agents manage exceptions and decisions. By coordinating AI agents, RPA, systems and people within well-governed, scalable workflows, healthcare organizations can create better patient care, operations and clinician focus. SS&C Blue Prism agentic automation provides guardrails by combining AI-powered orchestration and automation, along with other technologies such as natural language processing (NLP), machine learning (ML), task and process mining, etc. SS&C Blue Prism agentic automation provides guardrails by combining AI-powered orchestration and automation, along with other technologies such as natural language processing (NLP), machine learning (ML), task and process mining, etc.
